How does a conversation become a project?

Know what you’re
saying yes to.

You should be able to see the work, understand the decisions and know who needs to act next.

01 / FIRST CONVERSATION

Bring the situation.

We discuss the objective, what already exists and who is involved. The first call helps establish fit and the next information needed.

02 / SCOPE & DECISIONS

See the shape of the work.

We define deliverables, responsibilities, cost and timing in a proposal. If deeper research or technical discovery is needed, we scope it first.

03 / BUILD & DELIVERY

Build it with us.

You review the work as it takes shape. Testing, launch, access, handover and ongoing support follow the agreed scope.

Before you get in touch

A few things
worth knowing.

There’s room for a specific project, a wider plan, or an objective that still needs defining.

Want to think it through first? Try a workbook↗
Do I need to know which service to ask for?

No. Tell us what you want to achieve or what has become difficult. If you already have a brief, bring it—we can start there.

Can you work with our existing team and tools?

Yes, where the project allows. We first understand what is working, the access available and who will own each responsibility. A new platform is not assumed.

How do you decide the cost and timeline?

We look at the deliverables, complexity, dependencies and review process. Those become a scoped proposal. The initial consultation is free; deeper audits or technical discovery are agreed separately.

What will we own when the work is complete?

Your agreement sets out the custom deliverables, code, assets, data and access to be handed over, subject to its terms and payment. Third-party licences, hosting and ongoing services are identified separately.
